tools.name: answerpool_search_catalog
tools.description: FIND THE RIGHT DATA PRODUCT. Search 130+ computed products across SEC filings and fundamentals, federal regulation, procurement and grants, NIH, clinical trials, FDA recalls and adverse events, US macro indicators, weather and severe-weather alerts, known-exploited software vulnerabilities, research

tools.name: answerpool_get
tools.description: RUN ANY of the 133 AnswerPool products by id — this plus answerpool_search_catalog is the main path, and every product is reachable this way. Find an id with answerpool_search_catalog, then pass its inputs as a JSON object, e.g. {"product_id": "weather_alerts", "params": {"area": "CA"}}. Covers SEC

tools.name: answerpool_list_products
tools.description: List all AnswerPool products with prices, inputs and when to use each.

tools.name: answerpool_credit_balance
tools.description: Check the remaining credit balance for your API key.

tools.name: answerpool_sec_company
tools.description: One-call SEC snapshot of a US public company: recent filings, indexed events, insider activity, key XBRL facts (revenue, income, cash). $0.02/call.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "answerpool_get" is 756 chars, far longer than this server's median (147). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
